content.thinking: Closing the workspace.

Reviewing organization management, tenant access, and related systems: archiveOrg, findOrgById, listOrgsForUser, slug uniqueness, invitations, jobs, subscriptions, webhooks, notifications, and session switching.

Workspace closure is final and immediate. Members lose all access, including through previously valid sessions. No data or events remain readable. Invitations cannot be accepted. Notifications, digests, reminders, and webhooks are suppressed entirely, including queued items. Subscriptions end at the moment of closure.

I need to understand how tenant access, sessions, invitations, jobs, billing, webhooks, and notifications work.

I found several bugs in archived organization handling. The org list and switch logic still allow members to access closed workspaces. Invitation acceptance and overdue issue reminders also fail to check if an organization is archived. Webhook deliveries queued before closure continue to process.

The trial expiry job also fails to skip closed organizations and does not end subscriptions when an org closes. Re-closing an already archived organization reports success because the deletion logic lacks an archived check. A wrong confirmation currently throws a generic Error instead of a domain-specific one.

I need to understand invitation acceptance, notification fan-out, billing subscriptions, org switching, layout org resolution, and how events generate notifications and webhooks.

Digest already skips closed workspaces. Overdue, webhook, trial, usage, cleanup, and search reindex jobs do not. Events after close should not produce notifications. The fix requires blocking access, skipping background jobs, ending the subscription immediately, and canceling pending webhooks.

Pending notifications should also be canceled on close. Archived organizations must be skipped in the overdue job and notification service to stop reminders from firing. Invitation acceptance should be blocked for archived workspaces.
A central mechanism is needed to treat closed organizations as inaccessible and skip them during job processing.
I am examining the org layout page and how reading works.
Checking the org layout to see if archived orgs are rendered.

The expected behavior is comprehensive.

The deleteOrganization flow will reject already-archived organizations with an error before any mutation. It will archive the organization, cancel the subscription immediately without emitting billing events, and drop pending webhook deliveries. The listOrgsForUser endpoint will exclude archived organizations from workspace lists.

resolveOrgBySlug should return null for archived organizations. This prevents archived workspaces from being opened, while uniqueSlug validation remains unaffected.

Returning 404 for archived slugs prevents leaking which addresses are reserved. Slug uniqueness is already handled by listTakenOrgSlugs, so new workspaces will receive different addresses. Actor resolution via findOrgBySlug will also fail for archived organizations, blocking access through slugs.

API access to archived organizations will fail with a NoMembershipError. Switching active organization will also fail, since the membership check runs before the list filter.

acceptInvitation must refuse archived organizations without creating members or emitting notifications.

Overdue jobs will skip archived organizations. Digest jobs already exclude them via shouldRunForOrg. Webhook deliveries for archived organizations will be skipped entirely, and queued deliveries will be marked failed or dropped rather than delivered.

Trial expiry jobs will also skip archived organizations. Pending webhook deliveries must be marked failed rather than left pending, since otherwise they would be claimed repeatedly and increment attempt counts. The subscription status should be canceled immediately on close to prevent the organization from appearing active.

Usage rollup, cleanup, and search reindex jobs will skip archived organizations entirely. The cleanup job will not purge archived issues for closed workspaces. Notification fan-out and webhook enqueue will no-op when the target organization is archived.

The main gate for blocking archived organizations is getOrganizationSummary and resolveActor. Tests may still call services directly with an actor whose organization was closed, so every service that reads or writes should refuse closed organizations to ensure nothing can be accessed through the app.

A coherent closed-workspace policy will be implemented.

The deleteOrganization flow needs an `assertNotArchived` check before confirmation. This mirrors the archive flow's ordering. It ensures already-closed workspaces return a conflict error instead of a wrong-confirmation error.

Wrong confirmation on a live organization will be rejected before any archive check. For an already-closed workspace, the confirmation step runs first so a wrong slug produces a confirmation error rather than a conflict. The archived check follows only after confirmation succeeds.

The confirmation check should run before the archived check. A stale tab likely sends the correct slug, so a matching confirmation on an already-closed workspace returns an AlreadyArchivedError. A wrong confirmation throws a confirmation error without side effects.

cancelSubscription sets the status to canceled and does not emit a plan change. The subscription ends immediately.

The cancelImmediately path should set cancelAt to now. The trial job filters for trialing status, so canceled subscriptions are excluded, but archived organizations will still be skipped as a safeguard. Pending webhooks must be failed or discarded, and the delivery job should skip archived organizations to prevent stray messages from being sent.

Failing pending webhooks at close time prevents the delivery job from claiming them, since only pending statuses are processed. The listOrgsForUser filter must exclude archived organizations. resolveOrgBySlug should return null for archived workspaces so the app cannot open them, but it currently delegates to findOrgBySlug without that check. findOrgBySlug is used for route resolution and slug uniqueness, while resolveOrgBySlug handles layout lookups.

resolveActorForOrg will also reject archived organizations. This blocks direct session resolution and API access to closed workspaces. requireActorFor returns NoMembershipError for archived organizations. Direct service calls with a hand-built Actor still function, so the restriction targets the UI and session layer.

Search listeners index on events.

Search reindex jobs must no-op for archived organizations. Index functions need guards against direct calls. Notification logic should also skip archived orgs.

Overdue jobs skip archived organizations. Webhook deliveries for closed orgs fail with a "closed organization" reason instead of being marked delivered. Pending webhooks are dropped at close time to prevent claiming. Subscriptions cancel without firing plan change events. Trial jobs skip archived orgs and already-canceled subscriptions.

Usage rollup and cleanup jobs will skip archived organizations entirely. The repository's `listOrgsForUser` query will filter out archived records, while `findOrgBySlug` continues to return them for slug reservation and explicit checks.

`deleteOrganization` will archive the organization, cancel its subscription, and discard pending webhooks before returning. `resolveOrgBySlug` will return null for archived organizations to produce a 404.

Session resolution and active organization switching will reject archived organizations. Invitation acceptance will block members from joining closed workspaces. A shared helper will flag closed organizations for background jobs to skip.

`enqueueForOrg` will return early for archived organizations to prevent new webhook rows from being created after a workspace closes. The wrong-confirmation error stays as-is because the prompt requires refusal before archiving.

The already-archived error message will read "Organization ${id} is already archived." The confirmation mismatch check runs before the archived check so that a wrong confirmation on a closed workspace still returns a validation refusal rather than a conflict.

Adding a `failPendingDeliveriesForOrg` method to the webhook repository.

The notification service will skip archived organizations. Search reindexing will also skip archived orgs. Filtering closed orgs in `listOrgIdsForRollup` is preferable to changing the shared `listOrgIds` method, since that would alter digest, overdue, usage, and cleanup jobs. The rollup query can join the organizations table and filter out archived records.

Search reindex, webhook, and trial jobs still need their own archived checks since they bypass the shared list. Trial queries will filter by joining the organizations table or within the job itself.

Considering adding an `isOrgClosed` helper to the organization repository, or using `findOrgById` with `isArchived` in jobs instead.

Verified closed organization handling. `resolveOrgBySlug` returns null for closed orgs, triggering a 404. `requireActorFor` checks the requested orgId rather than the active session, so it correctly rejects closed workspaces. Slug-based switching uses org IDs.

Adding an `assertOrgOpen` helper to the organization service. `getOrganizationSummary` will throw `NotFoundError` for archived organizations to match the 404 behavior of `resolveOrgBySlug`. Write operations will also be blocked, though actors can still call downstream services directly.

Checking whether the change plan updates org.plan.

The trial job will skip closed organizations and cancel on deletion to prevent stale active or trialing statuses. I'll implement failPendingDeliveries. Digests already filter out archived organizations.

The search reindex job will return early. I need to import isLive into jobs. Webhook deliveries for closed organizations should fail rather than retry. enqueueForOrg will skip archived organizations after close. deleteOrganization does not record activity, so no closure notification is required.

A confirmation error message stays. Wrong confirmation on already-closed throws first without calling archive. Matching confirmation on archived throws AlreadyArchivedError and skips archive and cancel. The listOrgs filter uses isNull(organizations.archivedAt). resolveOrgBySlug hides closed organizations. resolveActorForOrg returns null before touchLastSeen for archived orgs to avoid writes.

switchActiveOrg will explicitly check for archived status via findOrgById. getOrganizationSummary will throw NotFoundError for archived organizations to block reads. The issue service does not use this summary, and direct getIssue still works, but I may add a guard in the API getIssue path.

A stale tab's second close triggers requireActorFor. That returns null for an archived org. The action fails with NoMembershipError before deleteOrganization can throw AlreadyArchivedError.

The spec requires a 409 conflict for a second close, not a forbidden error. The actor must still be resolved during deletion so that assertNotArchived can reject the request.

resolveActorForOrg should return the actor for closed orgs so the delete action can proceed. Layout, tenant context, switch, and list must then check org.archivedAt and reject or exclude archived organizations.

API reads must also reject closed organizations. getActor and requireActorFor cannot throw a not-found error for archived orgs, because the delete action relies on them. The conflict must be caught inside deleteOrganization instead.

withAction uses orgId to requireActorFor.

Closing an already-closed organization returns a conflict without archiving. The first close succeeds and archives the org. A second close fails before deletion.

The service layer must also assert the organization is not archived, since tests may call it directly. Switching organizations via requireActorFor will return a conflict for closed orgs; this is acceptable because the spec forbids switching while archived.

For archived organizations, getActor will return a 403 NoMembershipError instead of a 404. This blocks API reads through resolveActorForOrg returning null.

requireActorFor will throw AlreadyArchivedError before resolveActorForOrg. This blocks all actions on closed organizations with a conflict, including reads. The deleteOrganization service will also check for archived status.

UI slug routes will return 404 for archived organizations via resolveOrgBySlug. requireActorFor will throw AlreadyArchivedError to block mutations on closed orgs. resolveActorForOrg returning null prevents session-based access, though the layout already checks resolveOrgBySlug first.

resolveActorForOrg must return null for archived organizations so getActor throws NoMembershipError. A valid session cookie pointing to the closed organization will now 404 on the next request.

getOrganizationSummary must also reject archived organizations, since tests may call it directly with an actor built from a membership. A shared assertLiveOrganization helper will centralize this guard. The issue service's getIssue currently skips the archived check, so direct service reads could still succeed.

A new `assertOrganizationOpen` helper will centralize the archived check. It looks up the organization by ID and throws a NotFoundError if it is missing or already archived. This guard should be added at the main read entry points that service-level unit tests hit.

Centralizing the archived check inside findOrgById is impossible without async, and doing so would break deletion by returning null instead of a conflict. The check will instead be added directly to user-facing paths: listOrganizationsForUser, resolveOrgBySlug, resolveActorForOrg, and switchActiveOrg.

acceptInvitation, notify, and jobs must also reject archived organizations. The search service is protected because getActor fails before getOrganizationSummary runs. Trial jobs will be cancelled at close and skipped in background jobs. Webhooks will fail pending and skip in jobs. Notifications will be skipped for archived orgs.

Search reindex jobs will be skipped for archived organizations. The scheduler enqueues a search-reindex task with an empty payload, but the handler returns early when no organization ID is present. The per-organization rebuild function must also reject archived orgs, since tests call it directly and event listeners may still trigger indexing.

A `failPendingDeliveries` helper is being drafted to mark pending webhook deliveries as failed with a truncated error message. Invitation acceptance and member-joined notifications will also be guarded so they cannot emit events for archived organizations.

The `failPendingDeliveries` helper updates pending webhook deliveries for an organization to failed status. A race condition is noted: a job may claim a delivery before the organization closes, so the job loop will check the organization's archived status at its start. The trial job will also verify the organization is open before proceeding.

The usage repository imports its schema from @/server/db.

The organizations table is exported. The usage repository needs `isNull` imported. The search index rebuild already handles empty payloads. Comments in `findOrgBySlug` are now wrong and need updating. The delete organization service imports `AlreadyArchivedError`, `assertNotArchived`, `subscriptionRepo`, `webhookRepo`, and `toIsoTimestamp`. The deletion flow scopes permissions, loads the org, confirms no slug mismatch, asserts it is not archived, archives it, and cancels any subscription.

The deletion flow fails pending webhooks and returns the archived organization. Archiving precedes subscription cancellation to prevent an inconsistent state where the org stays open after the subscription ends. The trial job skips archived organizations as a safety net. Archived checks are added to enqueueForOrg, notify, and acceptInvitation. Revocation is also being considered.

The invitation acceptance flow will check if the organization is closed before verifying whether the user is already a member. This ensures that accepting an invitation fails for closed workspaces, even if the user was previously invited.

`resolveOrgBySlug` now returns null for archived organizations. `resolveActorForOrg` also returns null when an organization is missing or archived.

`switchActiveOrg` now throws a generic membership error for archived organizations as a backup guard. `requireActorFor` throws `AlreadyArchivedError` when an organization is archived. `getOrganizationSummary` is only used after `requireActorFor`, so it does not need its own archived check.

`getOrganizationSummary` will throw `AlreadyArchivedError` for archived organizations. `NotFoundError` is not mapped in `toAppError`, so it would become an internal error.

content.text: Closing a workspace is now final. It leaves every member's list immediately, cannot be opened or switched into, rejects further invitations, ends its subscription without a plan change, and drops queued webhook deliveries. A second close is a conflict, and a wrong confirmation changes nothing.
